name: agent-inbox
title: Agent Inbox
description: 订阅 Claude Code 与 Codex 会话，在需要你输入时提醒，并跳回原对话。
author: 0xFango

commands.name: all-sessions
commands.title: 全部会话
commands.subtitle: Agent Inbox
commands.description: 找到任意会话并订阅，包括历史会话。Find and subscribe to any session.

commands.name: inbox
commands.title: 订阅列表
commands.subtitle: Agent Inbox
commands.description: 查看已订阅会话的状态，取消订阅或跳转回对话。View and manage subscribed sessions.

commands.name: settings
commands.title: 设置
commands.subtitle: Agent Inbox
commands.description: 管理 Agent 接入、语言、通知和恢复会话的终端。Manage agents, language, notifications, and terminal preferences.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: 刷新菜单栏
commands.subtitle: Agent Inbox
commands.description: 刷新菜单栏中的订阅会话和待输入数量；显示开关位于设置。Refresh subscribed sessions and the waiting count in the menu bar. Manage visibility in Settings.

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: 语言 / Language
preferences.description: 界面与通知语言。Language for the interface and notifications.

preferences.name: resumeTerminal
preferences.title: 默认终端 / Default Terminal
preferences.description: 优先跳回原会话；无法定位原窗口时，在所选终端恢复 CLI 会话。Focus the original session when possible; otherwise resume in the selected terminal.

scripts.bundle: npm run build:cli && ray bundle --output dist/agent-inbox.rayext && zip -q -d dist/agent-inbox.rayext '*.map' && zip -q -j dist/agent-inbox.rayext LICENSE
scripts.lint:code: eslint src cli test && prettier --check src cli test
scripts.check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:code && npm run build
